content_sections.heading: About JNCASR
content_sections.text: The Jawaharlal Nehru Centre for Advanced Scientific Research is an autonomous research institution under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, and an institution deemed to be a university. Its letterhead gives its address as Jakkur P.O., Bengaluru - 560064, Karnataka, India. The ERP Executive – Academic Systems will work on the institution's ERP and Student Information System (SIS) with its Academic and Administrative units.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: BE/BTech/MCA/MSc/MTech/MS/MIS or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics or related areas from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in ERP/Student Information System (SIS) implementation, administration, functional support, process digitization or related areas. Experience in universities, higher-education institutions, research institutions or other educational organizations will be highly preferred. Experience in Academic ERP / Student Information System (SIS) and understanding of student lifecycle and academic processes, including admissions, academic records, examinations, results and thesis/dissertation management. Experience in ERP/SIS implementation, requirement gathering, process mapping, fit-gap analysis, system configuration/customization, data migration, integration, testing/UAT and user training. Experience in coordinating with ERP/SIS vendors and technical teams. Understanding of APIs, databases and system integration. Knowledge of SQL, HTML, JavaScript, PHP, Python, Java or equivalent technologies will be an advantage. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills. The notice states that the position is primarily functional and implementation-oriented. Candidates are not required to be expert programmers in multiple programming languages; strong ERP/SIS implementation experience and higher-education domain knowledge will be given significant consideration. The age limit is preferably below 45 years as on the last date of application (16 December 2026). Candidates with exceptional relevant experience may also be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated remuneration of ₹75,000–₹1,20,000 per month, commensurate with qualifications and relevant experience. The appointment is contractual, initially for one year from the date of engagement, and the contract may be extended based on requirements and performance review. The notice lists these other entitlements: Leave: 1.5 days for each completed month of assignment. TA/DA: No TA/DA shall be admissible for joining the assignment. Accommodation/HRA: No accommodation or HRA will be provided. Transport Allowance: No transport allowance shall be provided.

content_sections.heading: JNCASR ERP Executive – Academic Systems Job Description
content_sections.text: As per the notice, the incumbent will: Gather and document requirements from Academic and Administrative units. Map institutional processes into ERP/SIS workflows and identify gaps and areas for improvement. Coordinate ERP/SIS implementation, configuration, customization and integration with vendors and technical teams. Coordinate data migration, testing, UAT and deployment. Facilitate user training, documentation and post-implementation support. Coordinate system enhancements, issue resolution and continuous improvement of the system.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JNCASR ERP Executive – Academic Systems
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed format given in Annexure - II of the notice (Application for the Post of ERP Executive – Academic Systems on Contract Basis). Combine the filled-in application, a recent CV and supporting documents for educational qualifications and experience into a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file to [email protected] on or before 16 December 2026. Name in full (in block letters), father's/spouse name and date of birth. Correspondence address and permanent address. E-mail address and phone number (mobile/landline). Educational/technical qualifications in chronological order of the examinations passed from Master's onwards, with a copy of the certificates. Experience (a separate sheet may be annexed) and additional relevant information, if any. Signed declaration with place, date and a passport size photograph. Duly filled-in application in the prescribed format Recent CV Supporting documents for educational qualifications Supporting documents for experience Passport size photograph (on the application form)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says the details of the selection method will be communicated only to the shortlisted candidates. It also says strong ERP/SIS implementation experience and higher-education domain knowledge will be given significant consideration.

The application, CV and supporting documents must be sent together as a single PDF file.
